capabilities: Log exercise sessions and custom habits with start/stop timers writing duration_min
Record gym sets with exercise, weight, and reps via an Add set form
Add and display cue cards on cue pages with hover and tap enlargement
Render yearly heatmaps filterable by activity and a yearly dashboard with monthly hour bars
Track reading items with timers, a book shelf, and property dropdowns
extras: Unreviewed by Obsidian staff per the listing; detailed user guide lives in the repository (docs/USER_GUIDE.md path referenced); runs locally with no telemetry or account.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track habits and workouts over time, with timers, heatmaps, and per-habit summaries inside daily notes.
summary: Habit-tracking plugin that logs exercise, reading and custom habits with session timers, gym set logs, cue cards, heatmaps, and a yearly dashboard.
